source: ZXNAME0000XZ resembles ZXNAME0001XZ because many lanes can execute a common instruction together, but ZXNAME0002XZ explicitly warns that the two concepts are not identical. ZXNAME0003XZ exposes a fixed-width vector instruction with one control-flow path. ZXNAME0004XZ exposes individual threads to the programmer and groups them for execution.[1]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 类似于 ZXNAME0001XZ，因为许多通道可以一起执行公共指令，但 ZXNAME0002XZ 明确警告这两个概念并不相同。 ZXNAME0003XZ 公开了具有一个控制流路径的固定宽度向量指令。 ZXNAME0004XZ 向程序员公开各个线程并将它们分组以供执行。[1]
